# Appendix to pair_maps_guard_gates_2026_11_06.md: every node and pair (generated by summarize.py from out/run1 and out/igm)

Columns: guard = locality guard L / L_ref on stage-B state pairs; floor = effect floor P / N on the guard's input children (first pass). Arms: stock (the tree), guarded (g = 1 where fb <= 3 / sqrt(N_shell / 2)), guardf (same with the mask's f_eff), g=1 (no matching). Children source: pre = split_children_pre.txt, final = split_children.txt, diag = stage-B states. K* after guard/floor read as stock -> guarded. Pair names a/b: group or state a is the reference, b is matched onto it.
